issues: The whole shot was upscaled from a 480×270 design space, so dashboard text was 5–8px and soft and unreadable once enlarged
Modal and body text were tiny (3–5 design px), so the content could not be read and the technique was reduced to a gold frame
Candles were solid red and green, fighting the gold light for accent and muddying the black-gold look
Four actions were crammed into 2s; the light's journey lasted barely a dozen frames and the hand-offs were too fast to read
changes: Look = graphite (near-monochrome dark) with champagne gold as the only accent: candles are ivory solid / grey hollow, so only the light and the modal are gold
The opener is a 150px serif gold line, 'Trade with focus.', with an eyebrow; letters resolve from blur as tracking tightens and the glow breathes, then it lifts away from frame 20

The dashboard is rebuilt at 1600×900 native pixels (fictional trading terminal Sextant: watchlist, 64px price with mono candles, order ticket, positions); it rises in perspective, keeps drifting in yaw, then blurs, dims and pulls back to 0.93 from frame 58

The light is 'picked up' from the Focus button in the top bar, travels a Bézier arc stretching into a comet by tangent and speed, flattens into a horizontal pill, then splits and wraps the modal in both directions, flashing where it meets at the top before settling into a thin gold frame
The modal is publication-grade: 54px title, 25px body, two option cards (Focus selected in gold) and a gold confirm button; the panel lands first and content rises in layers 3–4f apart
Duration 60f → 136f so every phase has a full arc, ending on a clean 20f hold
